title: Purification and the Dividing of the Plunder
reflectionText: Eleazar gave instructions for purification, and Yahweh commanded how the captives and livestock were to be divided. The warriors' portion and the congregation's portion carried different levies. What distinctions do you notice between purification, division, and the portions given to the priest and the Levites?
editorialNotes: Packet 042 initial writer output; Traditional Short only. Each story lane retains all wording from its respective bundled source passage.
